items.title: Dynamics 365 2026 release wave 1 plan
items.notes: Last traditional wave plan cycle Apr–Sep 2026; Learn page states release plans stop publishing Sep 2026.

items.title: Power Platform 2026 release wave 1 plan
items.notes: Covers Power Apps, Pages, Automate, Dataverse, governance.

items.title: Release Plans retire; AI at Work roadmap becomes primary
items.notes: FAQ: no Sep 2026 Wave 2 plan. Saved My Release Plans views do not carry over. Message Center remains tenant-change source.

items.title: AI at Work roadmap (live)
items.notes: aka.ms/AIatWorkRoadmap; filter/export/RSS; use for post-wave planning.

items.title: 2026 release wave 2 — not published (404 + FAQ No)
items.notes: Learn URLs /dynamics365/release-plan/2026wave2/ and /power-platform/release-plan/2026wave2/ returned HTTP 404 when fetched.

items.title: 2027 release wave 1 — not published (404)
items.notes: Tried /2027wave1/ for D365 and Power Platform — both 404. Hub only lists through 2026 wave 1.

items.title: Classic look for model-driven apps no longer switchable
items.notes: All release channels including semi-annual; modern look default; admin settings removed. Also listed GA Apr 1 2026 in planned-features.

items.title: Editable Grid and Power Apps Read-Only Grid controls deprecated
items.notes: Continue until further notice; security fixes only; migrate to Power Apps grid control.

items.title: Power Automate mobile app (iOS/Android) deprecated and removed from stores
items.notes: Cloud flows unaffected. Alternatives: Teams Approvals, PA portal mobile browser, Power Apps mobile. Push/widget impacts.

items.title: Power Automate export from Visio desktop deprecated
items.notes: Existing exported flows continue; BPMN export UI removed.

items.title: Test Engine deprecated
items.notes: Use Power Platform Playwright samples.

items.title: Dataverse bring-your-own-key (BYOK) support discontinued
items.notes: Migrate to customer-managed keys (CMK); otherwise auto-revert to Microsoft-managed keys.

items.title: Before/after field values removed from Purview-bound Dataverse audit events
items.notes: Use Dataverse native audit APIs/tables for field-level deltas; Purview keeps metadata only.

items.title: 2011 SOAP endpoint planned shutdown (no hard date)
items.notes: Clients must use CrmServiceClient or ServiceClient; those continue after endpoint shutdown. Prefer Microsoft.PowerPlatform.Dataverse.Client.

items.title: Organization Data Service (OData v2.0) removal deferred
items.notes: Migrate to Web API OData v4; endpoint path /XRMServices/2011/OrganizationData.svc.

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse (legacy) connector deprecated
items.notes: Migrate to Microsoft Dataverse connector; migration assistant for many flows.

items.title: SQL Server connector V1 actions disabled
items.notes: Replace with V2 actions.

items.title: Canvas Power Apps mobile deep links require environment ID
items.notes: Existing links without env ID stop working; recreate shortcuts.

items.title: Power Pages Web API fields wildcard (*) removed
items.notes: Must set explicit column lists in Webapi/<table>/fields. Security hardening.

items.title: Power Pages list OData feed removed
items.notes: Migrate to Power Pages Web API.

items.title: Table permissions enforced on all forms/lists
items.notes: Regardless of Enable Table Permissions setting.

items.title: Export to Data Lake (LCS add-in) permanently stops
items.product: Dynamics 365 finance and operations / Dataverse analytics
items.notes: No extensions. Transition to Link to Microsoft Fabric (low-latency) or Azure Synapse Link. Does not turn off Fabric/Synapse Link profiles.

items.title: Synapse trusted-services firewall exception retirement extended
items.notes: Plan private endpoints / managed VNet for Synapse workspaces.

items.title: Power Platform dataflows in Dataverse for Teams retiring
items.notes: Does not affect dataflows outside Dataverse for Teams.

items.title: End of AI Builder capacity add-ons and seeded credits calendar
items.notes: No auto-conversion to Copilot Studio Credits; features continue on Copilot Credits. Contract terms may honor seeded/add-on through term.

items.title: Unified Service Desk deprecated
items.notes: Migrate to Copilot Service workspace.

items.title: Unified routing diagnostics removed
items.notes: Use Conversation diagnostics in Azure Application Insights.

items.title: Customer Service forecasting deprecated
items.notes: Use workforce engagement management forecast scenarios.

items.title: Apple Messages for Business channel deprecated
items.notes: Contact Microsoft Support for alternative channel options.

items.title: Sales Hub Dialer (preview) deprecated and removed
items.notes: Use Microsoft Teams dialer in Dynamics 365 Sales.

items.title: Sales Close Agent instances end
items.notes: Create Sales Development agent instead.

items.title: SharePoint MCP tools msdyn_GetDocumentSearchResults / msdyn_SalesAnswerFromDocuments deprecated
items.notes: Update customizations using these MCP tools.
